newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit retreats on renewed selling vs Sing.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit retreats on renewed selling vs Sing.

text.p: The ringgit retreated sharply after morning gains were wiped out by selling against the Singapore dollar, dealers said on Thursday.
The ringgit remained confined to its recent range but was heading towards testing the 2.50 support level.
At 1000 GMT, ringgit was at 2.4985/95 per dollar against 2.4980/85 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Wednesday. The Singapore dollar was at 0.5626/36 per ringgit against 0.5642/52.
"A perception is gaining ground that the trade deficit for July will be bad, though it may improve substantially over last year," said a dealer with a local bank.
Market expectations for July trade figure range from a 500 million ringgit surplus to one billion ringgit deficit.
In the morning, the ringgit recovered slightly on overnight fund buying in London triggered by a perception that the trade balance of Malaysia was improving, the dealers said.
July trade figures are expected in the next few days, though the Statistics Department declined to give a date of release.
